absoluteLevel.assessment: All four options already give the Russian clothing translations, and all denote upper-body clothing. The distinguishing information is the second English meaning coat of paint, not an ordinary fact about a coat. A Russian-speaking adult without sufficient English/polysemy knowledge cannot derive it from the clothes, the parallel glosses or a familiar unit/logical relation; they are left guessing. English speakers or English learners are the relevant familiarity group here, and no basis establishes this particular second sense as broadly known adult wardrobe knowledge. Absence of specialist fashion terminology does not by itself make the question EASY.

topicSuitability.assessment: The fashion taxonomy covers clothing items, designers, materials, silhouettes and fashion history. The tested discrimination here is which English word also denotes a layer of paint/material. All clothing names/translations are given, so no clothing construction, use, material, silhouette or history knowledge distinguishes the answer. The clothing meaning supplies the shared-word setup; knowing the non-clothing English meaning solves the question. This is the word-coincidence boundary described by GAME_SPEC, rather than an established interdisciplinary fashion fact.
